title: Resident engine and loader

exclude: the screen matrix, the bitmap's colours: $6F in every cell at the hand-over, then rewritten as the screen is drawn (output, not data)
include: engine code that the boot file copies under the I/O area

io: draw_tile_cells and draw_tile_cell run only from draw_tile, between its all_ram_in ($22DC) and io_back_in ($22E2): the tile set at $D000-$DD7F is read from the RAM under the I/O area
unpack_tile_set calls all_ram_in at $2722 and falls into io_back_in at $274E: it saves and restores the scroll copy at $DD80-$DDFF in the RAM under the I/O area
